title: Correct Electric Field
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the electric field E in both reference frames must be correctly stated.

title: Correct Magnetic Field
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the magnetic field B in both reference frames must be correctly stated.

title: Correct Lorentz Force
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the Lorentz force F in both reference frames must be correctly stated.

title: Correct Acceleration
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the acceleration a in both reference frames must be correctly stated.

title: Relativistic Factors Explanation
description: Important Criteria: A clear explanation of the relativistic factors affecting the results must be provided.

title: Frame Transformation Understanding
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate understanding of how fields transform between frames.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All expressions must include correct units where applicable.

title: Common Errors Check
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors.
